content: दासः .²1 Slave, servant in general; गृहकर्मदासाः <ls>Bh. 1. 1</ls>; गृह˚, कर्म˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A fisherman; निषादो मार्गवं सूते दासं नौकर्मजीविनम् <ls>Ms. 10. 34</ls>. .²3 A Śūdra, a man of the fourth caste. .²4 A knowing man, one who knows the universal spirit. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Vṛtrāsura. .²6 A demon. .²7 A savage, barbarian (<ab>opp.</ab> आर्य). .²8 A worthy recipient (दानपात्र). .²9 A word added to the name of Śūdra; <ab>cf.</ab> गुप्त.
